recommendation: Keep the source fix as the FHIR-37570 reconciliation. Address FHIR-53850 separately if it enters applied/published scope because it covers a broader R6 propagation audit across many canonical resources.
issue_request: FHIR-37570 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request to add a standard Reference search parameter named context-reference for Library.useContext.valueReference; the accepted resolution said to add it generally to CanonicalResource search parameters and reflect it through canonical resources.
initial_application: Commit 2804a4350a363475f42bfa15540df04a84a4cd68, merged via HL7/fhir#2288, added CanonicalResource-context-reference to source/canonicalresource/bundle-CanonicalResource-search-params.xml. That application chose the intended CanonicalResource-interface location, but the entry had a malformed standards-status extension URL, no build path extension, and the untyped expression {{name}}.useContext.value.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps CanonicalResource as an active interface resource and Library as an active concrete resource, so the CanonicalResource search-parameter bundle is in current build scope. The committers Zulip thread confirmed that interface search parameters inherit to implementing canonical resources. Current build evidence showed the other CanonicalResource context search parameters expanded to Library in search-parameters.json but no context-reference entry, and the CanonicalResource page showed an empty path for context-reference. Later FHIR-53850 is a broader R6 Resolved - change required issue about CanonicalResource search-parameter propagation and was treated as background, not a related decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/canonicalresource/bundle-CanonicalResource-search-params.xml to correct the standards-status extension URL, add the build path {{name}}.useContext.valueReference, and narrow the expression to ({{name}}.useContext.value.ofType(Reference)). No Library-local duplicate was added because the intended source location is the CanonicalResource interface.
source_changes: source/canonicalresource/bundle-CanonicalResource-search-params.xml: corrected the context-reference SearchParameter metadata URL, added the valueReference build path, and changed the expression to the Reference choice.

related_jiras.note: Broader R6 Resolved - change required issue about propagating CanonicalResource search parameters across all implementing resources; relevant background but not decided for this applied/published seed.
